fields.summary: Stock Management: Remove hand-written helper types
fields.description:
h3. Why

The module defines its own small helper types that duplicate what Java and Apache Commons already provide. One of them, {{StringUtils}}, shares its name with the Commons class used across the module, which is confusing.

h3. Description

Replace the module's own helper types with their standard equivalents and delete them.

h3. Details

* {{Action2}}: a two-argument callback, used by the stock operation type processors (8 files). Replace with {{java.util.function.BiConsumer}}.
* {{Pair}}: used in 3 files. Replace with the Apache Commons {{Pair}}.
* {{StringUtils}}: only holds an email check, used in 2 files. Move the check to where it is used, or use an existing validator.
* {{NumberFormatUtil}}: used in 4 files. Replace with standard number formatting where it adds nothing.

h3. Acceptance criteria

* {{Action2}}, {{Pair}} and the module's own {{StringUtils}} are removed.
* {{NumberFormatUtil}} is removed or reduced to what the standard library does not cover.
* No behaviour changes; the build and all tests pass.
